title: Wind speed probabilities, cycles of 28 October 2025 (Jamaica landfall)
description: NHC 120-hour cumulative 34/50/64-kt wind speed probability bands for the four forecast cycles of 28 October 2025 (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC), the day of the Jamaica landfall (about 17:25 UTC), clipped to lon -90 to -65, lat 10 to 25. One Collection per cycle.
